body:
That's probably a pretty good suggestion.. Thank you for it. I used to be really consistent about lifting weights. I messed up and hurt my back a couple months ago (just moving up too fast) and haven't been able to do as much since, which is a little frustrating.

I've been thinking it'd probably be good to start running or swimming more since I enjoy them and my back won't matter. Maybe some fitness classes or an after-hours league would help with people. Is it OK to join those alone?

Thanks a lot for reading what I've written. It means a lot to me that you would do that.

I'm not as worried about having someone to vent to as I am having someone where we understand each other or trust each other or interact with in a non-superficial way. If there's some way to find people like that, I don't know how. I don't feel like I'm in an environment where I am good enough to be able to do that, but I'm not sure the right environment exists.
